**Wire verb `sdrf assess`**: Decide whether each SDRF file's sample half describes an experimental design - Informative, Partial or Skeleton - with the per-column counts behind the verdict.

# Wraps

- [`SdrfSampleInformativeness.Assess`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfSampleInformativeness.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfSampleInformativeness.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`SdrfColumnCoverage`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfCoverage.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/Sdrf/SdrfCoverage.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

# Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` (wire `--path`) | `path` | absent | — | — | One .sdrf.tsv file. Exactly one of path and paths-stdin. |
| wire `--paths-stdin` | `flag` | absent | — | — | Many paths on stdin, as for sdrf validate. |
| `threads` (wire `--threads`) | `int` | `1` | documents | `>= 1, or -1` | Documents assessed at once; output identical at any value. |
| `on_error` (wire `--on-error`) | `string` | `fail` | — | `fail \| skip` | As for sdrf validate. |

# Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | — | never | The absolute path assessed. |
| `verdict` | `string` | — | never | Informative (all three checks pass), Skeleton (none), Partial (between). mzLib's SdrfSampleVerdict member name. |
| `factor_value_varies` | `bool` | — | never | Some factor value\[...\] column holds &gt;= 2 distinct real answers. |
| `sample_is_described` | `bool` | — | never | Some characteristics\[...\] column other than organism and biological replicate holds a real answer. |
| `biological_replicate_varies` | `bool` | — | never | characteristics\[biological replicate\] holds &gt;= 2 distinct real answers; false when the column is missing. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Data rows in the document. |
| `columns` (wire `column_names`) | `string[]` | — | never | The evidence table's columns. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | never | One row per column a check read: factor values, then sample characteristics, then biological replicate, each in mzLib's (ordinal) order. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Four static caveats. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source_index` | `int` | — | never | 0-based input position. *Present only with `--paths-stdin`.* |
| `source_path` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path. *Present only with `--paths-stdin`.* |
| `role` | `string` | — | never | factor\_value \| sample\_characteristic \| biological\_replicate: which check read this column. |
| `column_name` | `string` | — | never | The column as the header spells it. |
| `rows` | `int` | rows | never | Rows, counted once per row per column NAME (a repeated column does not inflate it). |
| `filled` | `int` | rows | never | Rows with a real answer in at least one of the column's cells. |
| `absent` | `int` | rows | never | Rows that are empty or a reserved word (any case): rows - filled. |
| `distinct_values` | `int` | values | never | Different real answers, compared case-insensitively after trimming. |
| `fill_rate` | `float` | fraction (0-1) | never | filled / rows; 0 when rows is 0. May cross as an integer 0 or 1. |

# Errors

| Kind | mzLibRust returns | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | as for sdrf validate (path / paths-stdin / threads / on-error rules, missing or repeated files) |
| `correctness` | [`MzLibError::Bridge`](crate::MzLibError::Bridge) | mzLib cannot read a document |
| `service_unavailable` | [`MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable`](crate::MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable) | never returned by this verb |

Any call can also fail on the way to mzLib or back, whatever the verb: [`MzLibError::BridgeNotFound`](crate::MzLibError::BridgeNotFound), [`MzLibError::Timeout`](crate::MzLibError::Timeout), [`MzLibError::Protocol`](crate::MzLibError::Protocol) or [`MzLibError::Io`](crate::MzLibError::Io).

# Caveats

- Partial is often legitimate (a single-condition study has nothing to vary); the booleans say which check failed and the caller decides.
- On the 1,236-file bigbio curated corpus at 4f823dcd mzLib measured 300 Informative, 742 Partial, 194 Skeleton.
- Organism is excluded from sample\_is\_described because a search can fill it without a human describing the samples.
- Looks only at the sample half; says nothing about structure (sdrf validate) or cross-file agreement (sdrf lint).
